blast_radius: Triages EDC items and sends DMs; a stall means items go unrouted.

throughput.derivation: Attempted loops.daily_counts() over the log; every record lacks a ts/at field, so all records are dropped by design.

floor.reason: no windowable history: log records carry no timestamp

notes: Record keys are exactly: completion, learn, reclassify, reconcile, sessions, snooze, triage — no ts.
Remedy: add a UTC 'ts' to each summary line; this entry then derives a floor with no further code change.

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: EDC triage loop (every 330s). NO WINDOWABLE THROUGHPUT SIGNAL: its log is JSONL with per-stage counters, but records carry no timestamp field of any kind, so no 24h window can be cut from it.
why_it_matters: The loop is loaded and its per-run counters are non-zero, but capmap cannot prove a 24h volume without fabricating one from the file's mtime — and a timestamp is not a count.
